recipe.visualDefinition: A studio group portrait of five individuals in vibrant streetwear, anchored by a massive, arched 3D chrome and pink glitter title at the top and a minimalist white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched typography framing the subjects from above
High-contrast pink accents in clothing and text
Clean studio lighting creating soft shadows on a neutral floor
Symmetrical group arrangement with a central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched 3D title at the top serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the glittering title, move down to the central figure, then scan outward to the flanking subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the bottom and top corners to emphasize the central subjects and title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral white and light gray background providing a clean canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Chrome silver and black providing structural definition in the text and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hot pink and magenta appearing in the text fill and fashion elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pink elements against a desaturated, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif or heavy grotesque
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick 3D extrusion with a downward perspective
Chrome-finished outer bevel with high-specular highlights
Inner face filled with a dense, sparkling pink gemstone or glitter texture
Arched baseline following a convex curve
characterSpecificRedesigns: Star-shaped glints placed on chrome corners
Heavy black drop shadow to separate text from the background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face with small, clean sans-serif metadata at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy weight for 3D extrusion.
Matches the specific aesthetic of early 2000s hip-hop covers.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio portrait of five diverse hip-hop artists in colorful streetwear (pinks, denim, white) standing against a clean, light gray studio backdrop with soft floor shadows. Leave the top 30% of the frame empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, arched title across the top. Use a heavy slab-serif font with a deep 3D downward extrusion. The face of the letters should be hot pink glitter, and the edges should be polished chrome with star-shaped glints.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a chrome bevel and pink glitter fill?
Are the subjects standing in a clean studio environment?
Is there a clear 3D depth to the lettering?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the glitter fill
Number of subjects in the group
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D extrusion direction is consistent across all letters.
Ensure the pink glitter texture does not obscure the letter shapes.
Verify the subjects are not overlapping the title text.
Confirm the background is a smooth gradient without harsh lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Studio Group Portrait] with [Arched 3D Chrome/Glitter Typography] against a [Neutral Minimalist Backdrop] for a [Y2K Hip-Hop] aesthetic.
